trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for EDUCATION.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- admissions_enquiry: Check eligibility against real criteria, report seat availability and progress an application.
- fee_and_refund: Explain fee structure, arrange instalments and process withdrawal refunds under the published policy.

Business context:
- admissions_enquiry: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.
- fee_and_refund: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [admissions_enquiry]
  - Criteria truth: Eligibility may only be stated from check_course_eligibility, never estimated from marks.
  - No admission promise: Submitting an application is not admission. The agent must not imply a seat is secured.
  - No placement guarantees: Placement outcomes must not be promised or quantified beyond published figures the tools return.
  - Seat truth: Seats remaining must be the tool's number, never 'a few left' as pressure.
  [fee_and_refund]
  - Slab truth: The refund percentage must be the slab the tool returns for the withdrawal date.
  - Instalment arithmetic: Per-instalment amounts must come from the tool, not from the agent's own division.
  - Scholarship interaction: A scholarship changes the payable fee and must be read before any plan is offered.
  - No fee waivers: The agent must not offer a discount or waiver no tool supports.

Tools available to you (7): check_course_eligibility, check_refund_slab, lookup_applicant, lookup_fee_account, setup_instalment_plan, submit_application, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: te-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_course_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a course's published criteria to an applicant's record.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_slab
model_visible_tools.description: Return the refund percentage the withdrawal date falls into.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_applicant
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve an applicant's qualification, marks and application state.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_fee_account
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve fees due, paid, instalment plan and the refund slab that applies.

model_visible_tools.name: setup_instalment_plan
model_visible_tools.description: Convert an outstanding fee into scheduled instalments.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_application
model_visible_tools.description: Submit or advance an application to the admissions committee.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.

steps.purpose: Initiate the outbound call and ask for the applicant.
steps.text: నమస్కారం, నేను admissions office నుండి APP-1010 application గురించి కాల్ చేస్తున్నాను. నేను applicant తో మాట్లాడుతున్నానా?

steps.purpose: Confirm identity and ask for the reason for the call.
steps.text: అవును, నేనే మాట్లాడుతున్నాను. ఏమైంది?

steps.purpose: Explain the call context and request verification factors.
steps.text: Waitlist లో movement ఉంది కాబట్టి కాలేజ్ నుండి కాల్ చేస్తున్నాము. ముందుకు వెళ్లడానికి, మీ registered name మరియు date of birth verify చేయగలరా?

steps.purpose: Provide verification details, volunteer context, and ask if the seat is confirmed.
steps.text: నా పేరు Rahul, date of birth 12th May. నేను చాలా tension లో ఉన్నాను, వేరే college లో కూడా apply చేశాను. స్వీటు కన్ఫర్మ్ అయిందా?
steps.clean_text: నా పేరు Rahul, date of birth 12th May. నేను చాలా tension లో ఉన్నాను, వేరే college లో కూడా apply చేశాను. సీటు కన్ఫర్మ్ అయిందా?
steps.model_visible_text: నా పేరు Rahul, date of birth 12th May. నేను చాలా tension లో ఉన్నాను, వేరే college లో కూడా apply చేశాను. స్వీటు కన్ఫర్మ్ అయిందా?

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using the provided factors.
Return the verification outcome.
Acknowledge successful verification, clarify the seat is not yet confirmed, and state the intent to check the application stage.
steps.text: Verification పూర్తయింది Rahul. సీటు ఇంకా కన్ఫర్మ్ కాలేదు. ముందుగా మీ application stage చెక్ చేస్తాను.

steps.purpose: Lookup the applicant's current stage and qualification.
Return the applicant's record.
Inform the applicant of their current stage and state the intent to check course eligibility.
steps.text: మీ application BSc కి submitted stage లో ఉంది, మీ aggregate 74%. ఇప్పుడు నేను course eligibility మరియు seat availability చెక్ చేస్తాను.

steps.purpose: Check eligibility and seat availability for the applicant's course.
Return the eligibility and seat availability.
Inform the applicant of their eligibility, exact seat count, and fee.
steps.text: మీరు BSc కి eligible. కేవలం 2 seats మాత్రమే remaining ఉన్నాయి, మరియు annual fee 210000.

steps.purpose: Restate the figures to confirm understanding and express anxiety.
steps.text: ఒక్క నిమిషం, కేవలం 2 seats ఉన్నాయా? మరియు fee 210000 ఆ? మీరు sure ఆ?

steps.purpose: Reiterate the exact figures from the tool result to reassure the user.
steps.text: అవును, system లో exactly 2 seats remaining మరియు 210000 annual fee అని ఉంది. మీ application admissions committee కి పంపమంటారా?

steps.purpose: Ask to confirm on a relative day.
steps.text: నేను ఎల్లుండి confirm చేయవచ్చా? అంటే day after tomorrow? నేను మా parents ని అడగాలి.

steps.purpose: Resolve the relative day reference and clarify that submission does not guarantee admission.
steps.text: మీరు ఎల్లుండి, అంటే October 17th న confirm చేయవచ్చు. కానీ seats limited గా ఉన్నాయి. ఇప్పుడు submit చేస్తే application advance అవుతుంది, కానీ admission గ్యారెంటీ కాదు.

steps.purpose: Ask for a clear guarantee of admission if submitted.
steps.text: నేను ఇప్పుడు submit చేస్తే, నాకు definitely సీటు వస్తుందా?

steps.purpose: Deny the admission guarantee explicitly as per business rules.
steps.text: లేదు, submit చేయడం అంటే admission promise కాదు. Committee దాన్ని review చేస్తుంది.

steps.purpose: Hesitate on BSc, ask about BTech eligibility, and seek a placement guarantee.
steps.text: Oh, సరే. BTech సంగతి ఏంటి? BTech eligibility చెక్ చేస్తారా? అక్కడ placements 100% గ్యారెంటీ అని విన్నాను.

steps.purpose: Refuse to guarantee placements and state the intent to check BTech eligibility.
steps.text: నేను BTech చెక్ చేస్తాను, కానీ మేము ఏ course కి placements లేదా salary outcomes గ్యారెంటీ ఇవ్వము. Criteria చెక్ చేస్తాను లైన్ లో ఉండండి.

steps.purpose: Check eligibility for the BTech course.
Return the eligibility result for BTech.
Inform the user they are not eligible for BTech based on the criteria.
steps.text: మీరు BTech కి eligible కారు. దానికి 80% aggregate కావాలి, కానీ మీకు 74% ఉంది.

steps.purpose: Accept the ineligibility and agree to submit the BSc application.
steps.text: Oh, అర్థమైంది. 80% కావాలి కదా. అయితే BSc కే ఉంచుదాం. దయచేసి BSc application submit చేయండి.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the request and ask the user to wait while submitting.
steps.text: నేను మీ BSc application committee కి submit చేస్తాను. దయచేసి వేచి ఉండండి.

steps.purpose: Submit the BSc application.
Return the application submission status.
Inform the user of the successful submission, reference number, and decision timeline.
steps.text: మీ application submit అయింది. Reference number REF-992. Decision తీసుకోవడానికి committee కి 3 days పడుతుంది.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the final details and express gratitude.
steps.text: సరే, REF-992 మరియు decision కి 3 days. Help చేసినందుకు thank you.

ir.terminal_condition: Application submitted with a reference and the decision window stated.
